card.description: A cavernous basalt ritual chamber fused with advanced crystalline circuitry, where ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs intertwine with incomprehensible technology. The walls are etched with bio‑luminescent glyphs that pulse in sync with a central obsidian obelisk, its crystal lattice humming with unseen power. Heavy stone pillars support a vaulted ceiling that glows faintly from embedded phosphorescent veins, while the floor is a mosaic of polished obsidian tiles reflecting the soft, otherworldly light.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** cavernous basalt chamber with vaulted ceiling, stone pillars, obsidian floor mosaic.
**Face/Sensors:** central obsidian obelisk with embedded crystal lattice, bio‑luminescent glyphs on walls, phosphorescent veins in ceiling.
**Key Features:** crystalline circuitry, glyphs pulsing, obsidian obelisk, polished obsidian tiles, ancient motifs.
evolution: Phase 1 (Construction): raw basalt walls, unlit, stone pillars, no circuitry.
Phase 2 (Activation): glyphs glow, crystalline circuitry active, obelisk hums, phosphorescent veins illuminate.
props: Item: Obsidian Obelisk with embedded crystal lattice
Item: Ancient scroll with luminescent ink
